description: NYAYA policy layer — deterministic rules engine. Conditions are evaluated against case facts; effects block steps, set deadlines, add guardrails and trigger escalations. The LLM has NO authority over these rules.
facts_doc: Supported facts: cause_active[code]=bool, step_status[key]=PENDING|BLOCKED|READY|DONE|REPLACED|SKIPPED, cause_set has code, scheme_is_pension=bool, has_urn=bool, fields_confirmed=bool, evidence_flag[f]=bool, step_owner[key]=str

rules.label: Name correction must complete before Aadhaar re-seeding (B06)

then.reason: B06: seeding is rejected while the bank name does not match Aadhaar. Fix the name first, then seed.

then.text: Do not submit Annexure I until bank KYC name matches Aadhaar exactly.

rules.label: Dormant account must be reactivated before re-seeding

then.reason: Re-seeding a dormant account will be rejected again. Reactivate the account first (small deposit + KYC).

then.text: A dormant account is reactivatable — do NOT close it.

rules.label: Closed account requires fresh seeding to an active account

then.text: Mapper must be re-pointed to an ACTIVE account; credits bounced off a closed account must be re-processed by the scheme.

then.reason: NPCI/UIDAI validation typically reflects in 24-48 hours.

rules.label: Re-processing request only after mapper is verified

then.reason: Re-processing before the mapper is fixed will bounce again. Sequence: fix mapper, then request re-process.

rules.label: Prepare CPGRAMS grievance if re-processing unanswered at T+15

then.reason: Escalation ladder: branch -> nodal officer -> scheme nodal -> CPGRAMS at T+15 if unanswered.
RTI is the last resort in the ladder; file after CPGRAMS window with URN references.

rules.label: Pension cases must schedule the annual life certificate check

then.reason: Pensions stop every year if the life certificate is not submitted before 30 November — a separate, parallel stoppage risk.

then.text: Life certificate deadline (30 Nov) is a cliff-edge — schedule it regardless of the current failure cause.

rules.label: Every external letter must quote the APBS URN

then.text: Quote the URN in every complaint — it lets the bank trace the exact APBS transaction. Without it, branches say 'no record found'.

rules.label: Documents may only be marked VERIFIED using confirmed identity fields

then.text: Unconfirmed extracted fields detected — documents remain in DRAFT until the beneficiary confirms them.

rules.label: Documents of replaced plan steps must be invalidated

then.text: Resolution plan changed after new evidence — documents generated for replaced steps are marked INVALIDATED with the reason shown.

rules.label: eKYC completion runs in parallel with bank fixes

then.text: eKYC does not depend on bank fixes — complete it at the CSC/portal immediately in parallel.

escalation_ladder.step: Bank branch visit with prepared documents
Bank nodal officer (written complaint with acknowledgement)
RTI to scheme PIO (+ first appeal if evasive)
